review.why: Diagnoses failed dbt platform jobs from run logs, the admin API, git history and data checks, never editing a failing test just to pass.
review.summary: Opens with an iron rule: do not change a test to make it pass without understanding why it fails, plus a table of rationalizations that mean stop. A workflow gathers run information through admin tools or user-supplied logs, classifies the error type, checks recent changes or the data, then fixes with a branch, a test and a pull request or writes up findings.
strengths: Rationalization table stops rushed fixes under pressure
Classifies infrastructure, code and data failures separately
Ends with a findings document when no root cause is found
cautions: For platform job failures, not local development errors
Needs admin API tools or exported logs
Investigation template is in a file not read here
